The right axis expands when an extreme enters view and contracts when it leaves. The built website alert example passed ten interaction states in each engine, with no page or example errors. Twenty-four alert and six autofit screenshots plus six representative built-site screenshots were inspected. Traffic uses fixtures rather than live brokers.
